description_en: Detach a user from a user attribute
description_zh: 解除一个用户与某个用户属性的绑定关系
name: DeleteUserPropertyValue

parameters.help_en: The user ID. You can call the [DescribeUsers](~~DescribeUsers~~) operation to query the user ID, which is the return value of the `Id` parameter
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID。可以调用[DescribeUsers](~~DescribeUsers~~)获取该参数，对应返回参数`Id`的值
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: The property ID. You can call the [ListProperty](~~ListProperty~~) operation to query the property ID
parameters.name: property_id

parameters.help_en: The property value ID. You can call the [ListProperty](~~ListProperty~~) operation to query the property value ID
parameters.help_zh: 属性值ID。可以调用[ListProperty](~~ListProperty~~)获取该参数
parameters.name: property_value_id
